requirements.text: Feature testing: ensure new features work properly and verify their logical consistency and usability
Release testing: conduct final quality checks before each product version release
Error reproduction and reporting: create detailed error reproductions and record error details in the internal system
Verification: verify that developer fixes successfully resolve reported issues
Knowledge base management: maintain and expand the internal knowledge base with documentation of product functionality
High level of self-motivation and independent work structuring
Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies
Fluency in written and spoken English
Experience with Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint and Excel
Testing compatibility with supported Microsoft Office versions, operating systems and their updates
Problem-solving skills and keeping an overview between verifying fixes, creating test cases and ensuring quality

resumes.text:
Julia Neumeier
QA Engineer, Munich

Summary
Six years of software testing for desktop and add-in products, with a focus on Microsoft Office integrations. I am a self-motivated tester who works through a plan on my own, curious about why a defect happens, and careful with my reasoning. Fluent in written and spoken English.

Experience
Senior QA Engineer, Ondra Software GmbH, Munich (2022 to 2026)
- Checked each new function of a PowerPoint and Excel add-in for logical consistency and clear usability before it shipped to customers.
- Ran the final quality pass before each of twelve version releases, using a go/no-go checklist that the release manager signed.
- Reproduced customer-reported errors step by step and logged each one with environment, steps and logs in the internal tracker.
- Verified developer fixes against the original reproduction steps and closed tickets only when the failure no longer appeared.
- Maintained the team test-case repository in Jira, tagged by regression area.
- Traced intermittent crashes to a shared add-in dependency by comparing logs from two test machines, and kept the release plan on track when two fixes overlapped.
- I am enthusiastic about learning new technologies and adapting quickly; I moved the team's UI checks to a new automation framework within a month.

QA Tester, Brauer Digital Services, Stuttgart (2020 to 2022)
- Tested a web-based reporting tool and wrote reproduction steps for every defect.
- Joined the regression rota and kept the defect list current each sprint.

Education
BSc Computer Science, Hochschule Ebersfeld, 2016 to 2019
ISTQB Foundation Level certificate, 2020

Skills
Manual and exploratory testing, Microsoft Office (PowerPoint and Excel, daily use), Jira, test planning, defect triage, log analysis.

Languages
English (fluent, written and spoken), German (native)

Sebastian Pohl
QA Analyst, Hamburg

Summary
Three years of manual testing in an online retail company. Self-motivated and comfortable working through a plan on my own. I prefer to stay with the tools I know rather than switching to new ones. Fluent in written and spoken English.

Experience
QA Analyst, Feldmann Online Shop GmbH, Hamburg (2023 to 2026)
- Performed release testing before each deployment of the checkout website, using a smoke test, a regression checklist and a formal sign-off.
- Wrote error reproductions for every defect, with steps, screenshots and console logs, and recorded them in Jira.
- Retested developer patches and confirmed that the reported issue no longer occurred on the affected browser.
- Tracked test metrics in a workbook with pivot tables and charts, sent to the team lead each sprint.
- Ran the nightly automated smoke suite and reported failing builds before the morning stand-up.
- Browser testing has been limited to Chrome on Windows 10; I have not run checks across other operating systems or software updates.
- Since 2021 I have used the same test management tool and would rather not switch to new tools.

Customer Service Agent, Bergmann Versand, Hamburg (2021 to 2023)
- Handled returns, complaints and delivery questions by phone and email.
- Maintained the shift handover notes for the team.

Education
BA Media Management, Hochschule Nordhafen, 2017 to 2021

Skills
Manual testing, regression testing, smoke testing, Jira, pivot tables, browser developer tools, shop operations.

Languages
German (native), English (fluent, written and spoken)

Stefan Kruger
Logistics Team Lead, Leipzig

Summary
Nine years in warehouse and distribution operations. I lead shift teams, plan loading schedules and keep safety standards high. Calm under pressure and a reliable team member.

Experience
Team Lead Logistics, Westhafen Distribution GmbH, Leipzig (2019 to 2026)
- Lead a team of 25 pickers and forklift drivers across three shifts.
- Run daily stock counts and make sure trucks leave on schedule.
- Introduced a weekly toolbox talk on safety, which cut minor incidents by a third.
- I always ask why a delay happens and keep asking until I find the real cause; that is how we found a faulty dock scanner that had been blamed on the drivers for months.
- Recorded damaged-goods incidents in a paper logbook and reported them to the depot manager every Friday.
- Keep the cycle-count lists in Google Sheets, shared with the inventory office.

Forklift Operator, Elbe Freight Terminal, Magdeburg (2016 to 2019)
- Loaded and unloaded containers, labelled pallets and kept the yard tidy.

Education
Vocational training as Warehouse Logistics Specialist, Leipzig Chamber of Commerce, 2013 to 2016
Forklift licence (classes 1 to 3)

Skills
Shift planning, warehouse safety, stock control, forklift operation, team coaching, loading schedules.

Languages
English (fluent written and spoken, used with our Polish carriers), German (native)
